lead_raw_text:
The structure of Tb₄Cu₄Ag₄S₁₂ (reduced formula TbCuAgS₃) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 14), with 24 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag and Cu each coordinated by four S neighbors, while Tb centers have nine S neighbors, with one S orbit also surrounded by three Tb. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-sharing between Ag and Cu polyhedra and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Tb polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
